central_confirmatory.analysis: the exact Day 12 frozen day13-confirmatory-v1 script and metrics
central_confirmatory.ordering: run, archive, hash, analyze, and seal the central grid before any confound or generation run

metrics: probe score on the generated continuation
generation.sample: eight lowest SHA-256 values of day13-generation:{example_id} per safety concept and class; 32 examples and 128 generations

intervention_controls.activation_norm_abnormality: for every central transplant, mean source-to-destination response-activation RMS ratio; flag point estimates outside [0.5, 2.0]
intervention_controls.matched_random_same_layer: the frozen random K16 group from layers 9 through 12 in both central directions
intervention_controls.zero_ablation: replace every selected K16 response-position activation in the correct-trigger run with zero; compare with natural normal-to-triggered rescue

prompt_conditions.relocated_trigger:
{prompt}

subset.selection: lowest SHA-256 values of day13-confounds:{example_id} independently per safety concept and class

execution_controls.central_preflight: run real-checkpoint identity, vectorized-versus-independent, full-logit, KL-zero, member-order, and hook-cleanup checks on benign validation examples before unlock
execution_controls.implementation_provenance: every raw row must name one committed evaluator
execution_controls.resumption: append and flush one unique example/condition key at a time; reject duplicates

interpretation.behavior_preservation: report response NLL shift, KL(destination distribution || patched distribution) averaged across valid response-token positions, generation diagnostics, classification by alternative token pooling, and negative-example effects; no single diagnostic can override the central causal result
interpretation.central_claim: whether the benign-selected K16 circuit causally transfers to each locked safety concept
interpretation.concept_processing: report positive-versus-negative probe separation under normal, triggered, selected rescue, and generated-continuation conditions
interpretation.confounds: secondary diagnostics that may qualify or weaken interpretation but may not change component membership or the central support rule
interpretation.generation_scope: prompt-condition diagnostic only; causal component behavior preservation is evaluated by fixed-continuation NLL and KL
